title: KLIA2 Bus Station: How to Walk There from Arrivals
metaDescription: The KLIA2 bus station is in the Transportation Hub on Level 1. Follow the walk from the arrival hall to the bus counter, with ttklia's video.

contentBlocks.content: The KLIA2 bus station is in the Transportation Hub on Level 1, one floor below the arrival hall. Come out of arrivals by Door B, walk straight through the Gateway@klia2 shops, turn left after FamilyMart and take the travelator down to Level 1. The bus counter and ticket kiosks are ahead of you. The whole walk is indoors, and trolleys can go on the travelator.
Key Takeaways
Which floor is the bus station on? Level 1, in the Transportation Hub. You arrive on Level 2.
Which way do I leave the arrival hall? By Door B. Then follow the signs for Bus and Taxi (Bas dan Teksi).
Where do I buy a bus ticket? At the bus counter or the self-service kiosks on Level 1. You can also book on ttklia.com before you fly and keep the e-ticket on your phone.
Where is Grab pickup? Also in the Transportation Hub, on the LG floor. Follow the e-hailing signs.
Watch the walk first
ttklia filmed the route from the KLIA2 arrival hall to the bus counter. It runs under a minute. Watch it before you land so the signs look familiar when you see them.
Video: ttklia on TikTok
Step by step: arrival hall to the bus counter

1. Leave the arrival hall by Door B. After baggage and customs you come out on Level 2. Look for the pillar marked with a large B.
  2. Walk straight under the overhead signs for Bus and Taxi (Bas dan Teksi).
  3. Pass the green AirAsia MOVE billboard and keep going into the Gateway@klia2 mall.
  4. Go straight past Homeworld and ZUS Coffee.
  5. Find the direction board that says "You Are Now At Level 2". FamilyMart is on your left.
  6. Turn left at the sign that lists Level 1: Bus & e-Hailing (Bas & e-Hailing).
  7. Take the travelator down, signposted Transportation Hub, Level 1. Read the trolley safety sign at the top if you have one.
  8. On Level 1, head towards the Transportation Hub lifts.
  9. The bus counter is the row of numbered windows ahead of you, behind the QMac shop. The self-service ticket kiosks are further along the same row, by Door 3 (Pintu 3).
If you get turned around, look up. Every direction board in KLIA2 lists the floors, and the bus is always Level 1, marked with a bus icon and "Bas & e-Hailing".
At the bus counter

Buses from the KLIA2 Transportation Hub go to KL Sentral, Pudu Sentral (shown as KL City Centre on booking sites), Lalaport BBCC and TBS in Kuala Lumpur, to KLIA Terminal 1, and further afield to Melaka, Ipoh, Penang, Johor Bahru and Singapore.

You can buy a ticket at the counter or a kiosk when you get there. If you book before you fly, you skip that queue: show the e-ticket on your phone and ask at the counter if you are unsure which door your bus leaves from. Check that your phone has data before you leave the arrival hall. If you booked a Teeko travel SIM, collect it at the tour centre in KLIA2 on your way; the exact counter details come with your booking.

contentBlocks.content: Not taking the bus?

• KLIA Ekspres and KLIA Transit trains. Buy your ticket at the counters or machines on Level 2 of Gateway@klia2, then go down one level to the platforms on Level 1.
  • Grab. Pickup is in the Transportation Hub on the LG floor. Follow the e-hailing signs past Level 1.
  • A booked taxi. You do not need to walk to the hub at all. A fixed price taxi booked on ttklia.com comes with a driver who tracks your flight and waits in the KLIA2 arrival hall with a name board.
Going to KL Sentral and not sure which to pick? Our KLIA2 to KL Sentral guide compares the bus, the train, taxi and Grab on time and fare.
Frequently Asked Questions
Where is the bus station at KLIA2?

The KLIA2 bus station is in the Transportation Hub on Level 1. From the arrival hall on Level 2, leave by Door B, walk through the Gateway@klia2 shops, turn left after FamilyMart and take the travelator down.
Is the KLIA2 bus terminal the same as the Transportation Hub?
Yes. Signs in KLIA2 call it the Transportation Hub (Hab Pengangkutan Awam). The bus counter, ticket kiosks and bus departure doors are on its Level 1.
Can I buy a bus ticket at KLIA2 without booking?
Yes. There is a staffed bus counter and a row of self-service kiosks on Level 1. Booking ahead on ttklia.com lets you skip the queue and see departure times before you land.
Where do I catch a Grab at KLIA2?
Grab pickup is in the Transportation Hub on the LG floor. Follow the same route to Level 1, then the e-hailing signs down one more level.
Conclusion

From the KLIA2 arrival hall, the bus station is one floor down: Door B, straight through Gateway@klia2, left after FamilyMart, travelator to Level 1. Watch ttklia's video once before you fly, then pick your bus on ttklia.com so your ticket is ready when you reach the counter.
